method: Direct item-body inspection of fifteen consecutive letters in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan. PDF pages 516-532 were rendered and visually checked; page-resolved extracted text supported bounded research paraphrases. No blocked crawler was used.
identity_relation: Fourteen visible letter identities already had bibliographic records and were enriched. The older conservative index left ד׳תשלט unresolved; the visible heading, complete public-letter body and printed location establish a new scan-confirmed canonical identity.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: The second item is a forwarding/follow-up letter for the first and is not independent evidence for the enclosed text.
This letter belongs to the already established shipping correspondence family; it adds a distinct letter witness but not independent confirmation of ship operations or halachic facts.
The two letters overlap in the same management conflict and are one evidence family for reconciliation claims.
